snippet.title: Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection – Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Transcode! Mega Man! 

Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection is now available on Nintendo Switch™, PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and Steam!

Experience all 7 games in the Mega Man Star Force series in one stellar package!
Mega Man Star Force Pegasus 
Mega Man Star Force Leo 
Mega Man Star Force Dragon 
Mega Man Star Force 2 Zerker x Ninja 
Mega Man Star Force 2 Zerker x Saurian 
Mega Man Star Force 3 Black Ace 
Mega Man Star Force 3 Red Joker

Follow Geo Stelar and his extraterrestrial partner, Omega-Xis, as they fuse to become the champion of Earth: Mega Man! Enjoy gripping stories, engaging combat, and forge bonds across the stars with the Brother Band system! Featuring online battles and trading, a gallery of amazing artwork and music, new quality of life features, and much more, reach for the stars in this perfect collection!

Additionally, Sonia Strumm and Luna Platz are now available as optional DLC for your main menu screen.

Official website: https://www.capcom-games.com/megaman/starforce/en-us/


Discord: https://discord.gg/Capcom
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/CapcomUSA
Twitter: https://twitter.com/CapcomUSA_
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/CapcomUSA
